name: What is the typical lifespan of kitchen cabinets and countertops?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical lifespan of kitchen cabinets and countertops?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of kitchen cabinets and countertops varies based on materials, quality, and usage. Generally, well-maintained solid wood or high-quality plywood cabinets can last 30-50 years. Laminate countertops might need replacement after 10-15 years, while natural stone like granite or quartz can last 40-100 years or more with proper care. Regular cleaning and avoiding harsh chemicals will extend their longevity. Consider your lifestyle and long-term plans when choosing materials.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen cabinet lifespan ranges from 30-50 years, while countertops vary; laminate lasts 10-15 years, and natural stone can last 40-100 years or more.
